steps.about: No timer on this one. The clock is the thing being tested.
steps.title: Write what you are starting

steps.about: Then stop. Noticing is the skill; the timer was standing in for it.
steps.title: Work until you notice you have stopped

steps.about: After a week of these you will know your own number, and it will not be twenty-five minutes.
steps.title: Write down where you got to and how long it was
Break, about a fifth of that
